results.title: Did You Know NVIDIA Is 33 Years Old? Why This 1993 Company Is Suddenly Everywhere?
results.description: Founded in 1993 to improve computer graphics for gaming, NVIDIA invented the GPU in 1999 to process multiple tasks simultaneously. Researchers later discovered this parallel processing power was perfect for handling massive datasets and complex math.
